title: bidens bidentoides var. typica
intro: Bidens bidentoides var. typica, commonly known as Australian tick trefoil, is a plant species that belongs to the daisy family (Asteraceae). It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Bidens bidentoides var. typica are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial activity against certain pathogens. The bioactive constituents responsible for its therapeutic effects are primarily flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which have been identified in its leaves, stems, and roots.
